anotoki.language.label.description: The anotoki library's language switcher: the small heading above the languages on offer, and the accessible name of that group. The languages themselves are shown in their own names and are not strings. No placeholders.

anotoki.language.button.description: The anotoki library's language switcher: the accessible name of its button, which shows only the current language's code ("SK"). {name}: that language in its own name ("Slovenčina"), shown as it is. {code}: the code the button shows - keep it in, for somebody who speaks to the computer names the button by what it shows (WCAG 2.5.3, Label in Name). Placeholders: {name}, {code}.

anotoki.language.notLoaded.description: The anotoki library's language switcher: said when the words of the language chosen there could not be fetched; the page stays in the language it was in. No placeholders.
anotoki.language.notLoaded.en: The language could not be loaded. Try again.
anotoki.language.notLoaded.sk: Jazyk sa nepodarilo načítať. Skús to znova.

anotoki.language.notSaved.description: The anotoki library's language switcher: said to somebody signed in when the language chosen there could not be saved to their anotoki account (the IAM out of reach, the sign-in ended); the page stays in it until it is loaded again. Not said for a language the account does not offer - that one is the site's own choice. No placeholders.
anotoki.language.notSaved.en: The language could not be saved to your anotoki account - it holds for this visit only.
anotoki.language.notSaved.sk: Jazyk sa nepodarilo uložiť do tvojho anotoki účtu - platí len počas tejto návštevy.

anotoki.siteStatus.updatingTitle.description: The anotoki library's status page, while a database update waits (shown to everybody but the site's ADMIN): its heading. No placeholders.

anotoki.siteStatus.updatingText.description: The anotoki library's status page, while a database update waits: the sentence under its heading. The page asks again by itself and reloads once the site is back. No placeholders.
anotoki.siteStatus.updatingText.en: It will be back in a few minutes. This page reloads by itself.
anotoki.siteStatus.updatingText.sk: O pár minút bude späť. Táto stránka sa obnoví sama.

anotoki.siteStatus.unavailableTitle.description: The anotoki library's status page, while the site cannot reach its database: its heading. No placeholders.
anotoki.siteStatus.unavailableTitle.en: The site is not available right now

anotoki.siteStatus.unavailableText.description: The anotoki library's status page, while the site cannot reach its database: the sentence under its heading. The page asks again by itself. It speaks to the reader: a site that addresses its readers formally words it its own way. No placeholders.
anotoki.siteStatus.unavailableText.en: Please try again in a few minutes. This page reloads by itself.
anotoki.siteStatus.unavailableText.sk: Skús to znova o pár minút. Táto stránka sa obnoví sama.

anotoki.siteStatus.notSetUpTitle.description: The anotoki library's status page, on a site that was never set up: its heading. No placeholders.
anotoki.siteStatus.notSetUpTitle.en: This site is not set up yet
anotoki.siteStatus.notSetUpTitle.sk: Táto stránka ešte nie je nastavená

anotoki.siteStatus.notSetUpText.description: The anotoki library's status page, on a site that was never set up: the sentence under its heading, above the button to the setup page. No placeholders.
anotoki.siteStatus.notSetUpText.en: Its setup page connects it to its database and to the anotoki sign-in.
anotoki.siteStatus.notSetUpText.sk: Stránka nastavenia ju prepojí s databázou a s prihlasovaním anotoki.

anotoki.siteStatus.openSetup.description: The anotoki library's status page, on a site that was never set up: the button that opens its setup page. No placeholders.

anotoki.siteStatus.tryAgain.description: The anotoki library's status page: the button that asks the site again at once, instead of waiting for the page to ask by itself. No placeholders.

anotoki.siteStatus.signIn.description: The anotoki library's status page, while a database update waits and nobody is signed in: the quiet link to sign in, which is how the site's ADMIN gets to the update. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.close.description: The anotoki library's dialogs and side panels: the accessible name (and tooltip) of the button with an X that closes one. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.dismiss.description: The anotoki library's notifications (the short messages in a corner of the page): the accessible name (and tooltip) of the button with an X that puts one away. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.notifications.description: The anotoki library's notifications: the name screen readers give the corner of the page where they appear. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.cancel.description: The anotoki library's "Are you sure?" question: the button that answers no, where the page does not word it its own way. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.confirm.description: The anotoki library's "Are you sure?" question: the button that answers yes, where the page does not word it its own way. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.retry.description: The anotoki library's box for something that could not be loaded: the button that asks again, where the page does not word it its own way. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.optional.description: The anotoki library's form fields: the small word after the label of a field that may stay empty, in small letters. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.loading.description: The anotoki library's spinner: what a screen reader hears while something loads (and what it says beside it, where it says anything). No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.showPassword.description: The anotoki library's password field: the accessible name (and tooltip) of the eye button while the password is hidden. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.hidePassword.description: The anotoki library's password field: the accessible name (and tooltip) of the eye button while the password is shown. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.copy.description: The anotoki library's copy button: its words, where the page gives it none of its own. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.copied.description: The anotoki library's copy button: its words for a moment after it copied. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.copyToClipboard.description: The anotoki library's copy button that shows only an icon: its accessible name and tooltip. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.copiedToClipboard.description: The anotoki library's copy button: what a screen reader is told once the text is copied. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.copyFailed.description: The anotoki library's copy button: said when the browser would not copy (no permission, a page not served over https), so the reader copies the text by hand. No placeholders.
anotoki.ui.copyFailed.en: Copying did not work. Select the text and copy it yourself.
anotoki.ui.copyFailed.sk: Kopírovanie nefungovalo. Označ text a skopíruj ho ručne.

anotoki.ui.qrCode.description: The anotoki library's QR code: the accessible name of the picture, where the page gives it none of its own. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.or.description: The anotoki library: the small word on the line between two ways of doing the same thing (one way of signing in, or the other), in small letters. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.pages.description: The anotoki library's page numbers under a long list: the accessible name of that row of buttons. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.previous.description: The anotoki library's page numbers under a long list: the button to the page before. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.next.description: The anotoki library's page numbers under a long list: the button to the page after. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.range.description: The anotoki library's page numbers under a long list: which of its items are shown. {first}: the first one shown, {last}: the last one shown, {total}: how many there are. Placeholders: {first}, {last}, {total}.

anotoki.ui.pageOf.description: The anotoki library's page numbers under a long list: where in the list the reader is. {page}: the page shown, {pages}: how many pages there are. Placeholders: {page}, {pages}.

anotoki.ui.nothingToShow.description: The anotoki library's page numbers under a long list: said instead of the items shown while the list is empty. No placeholders.

anotoki.topbar.skipToContent.description: The anotoki library's top bar: the link that shows on the first press of Tab and takes the keyboard past the bar to the page itself. No placeholders.

anotoki.topbar.sections.description: The anotoki library's top bar: the name screen readers give the row of the site's own links (its sections), where the site gives it none of its own. No placeholders.

anotoki.topbar.phoneMenu.description: The anotoki library's top bar on a narrow screen: the accessible name of the button that opens the menu holding the site's links. No placeholders.

anotoki.topbar.menuButton.description: The anotoki library's top bar: the accessible name of the round button with the person's initials, which opens their menu. {name}: the person's name, as their anotoki account has it. Placeholders: {name}.

anotoki.topbar.menu.description: The anotoki library's top bar: the name screen readers give the person's menu itself. No placeholders.

anotoki.topbar.roleAdmin.description: The anotoki library's top bar: the person's role, under their name at the top of their menu, when they are the site's administrator. No placeholders.

anotoki.topbar.roleEditor.description: The anotoki library's top bar: the person's role, under their name at the top of their menu, when they are one of the site's editors. No placeholders.

anotoki.topbar.account.description: The anotoki library's top bar: the item of the person's menu that opens their account at anotoki (their profile, password and sign-ins) in a new tab. "anotoki" is the name of the accounts, never translated. No placeholders.

anotoki.topbar.admin.description: The anotoki library's top bar: the item of the person's menu that opens the site's admin panel. No placeholders.

anotoki.topbar.signIn.description: The anotoki library's top bar: the button that signs in, while nobody is signed in. No placeholders.

anotoki.topbar.signOut.description: The anotoki library's top bar: the last item of the person's menu, which signs them out. No placeholders.

anotoki.topbar.saving.description: The anotoki library's top bar: said in place of "Sign in" or "Sign out" while what was changed last is still being saved, and the item waits for it. No placeholders.

anotoki.topbar.linkCount.description: The anotoki library's top bar and side navigation: what a screen reader hears after the name of one of the site's links that has a number beside it - the new feedback in an admin panel: "Feedback, 3 new" - where the site does not word what its number counts itself. Heard, never seen: the number alone stays beside the link. {count}: the number. Placeholders: {count}.

anotoki.theme.label.description: The anotoki library's theme switch (light, dark, as the device is set): its small heading, and the accessible name of the group. No placeholders.

anotoki.theme.light.description: The anotoki library's theme switch: the light look. No placeholders.

anotoki.theme.dark.description: The anotoki library's theme switch: the dark look. No placeholders.

anotoki.theme.auto.description: The anotoki library's theme switch: the look that follows the device's own setting. No placeholders.

anotoki.theme.autoHint.description: The anotoki library's theme switch: the tooltip that says what the automatic look is. No placeholders.

anotoki.theme.notSaved.description: The anotoki library's theme switch: said to somebody signed in when the look chosen there could not be saved to their anotoki account; the page shows the account's own again. No placeholders.
anotoki.theme.notSaved.en: The theme could not be saved to your anotoki account.
anotoki.theme.notSaved.sk: Vzhľad sa nepodarilo uložiť do tvojho anotoki účtu.

anotoki.signIn.signingIn.description: The anotoki library's sign-in page (the site's address the anotoki account sends the reader back to): what it says for the moment the sign-in is being finished, before the page the reader was on comes back. No placeholders.

anotoki.signIn.failedTitle.description: The anotoki library's sign-in page: the heading over why a sign-in came back without one, could not start, or cannot be offered right now - the reason under it, then the buttons to try again and to go back. No placeholders.

anotoki.signIn.notCompleted.description: The anotoki library's sign-in page: said when the reader came back from their anotoki account without signing in - they went back from its page, or the account was turned away. Under it, the buttons to try again and to go back. No placeholders.

anotoki.signIn.expired.description: The anotoki library's sign-in page: said when a sign-in came back that did not start on this page or took too long (an old tab, a link opened twice). No placeholders.
anotoki.signIn.expired.en: The sign-in took too long or did not start on this page. Try again.
anotoki.signIn.expired.sk: Prihlásenie trvalo príliš dlho alebo sa nezačalo na tejto stránke. Skús to znova.

anotoki.signIn.storageUnavailable.description: The anotoki library's sign-in page: said when the browser does not let the site keep anything (its storage blocked or switched off), so a sign-in cannot even start. No placeholders.
anotoki.signIn.storageUnavailable.en: This browser does not let the site remember a sign-in. Allow the site's storage, then try again.
anotoki.signIn.storageUnavailable.sk: Tento prehliadač nedovolí stránke zapamätať si prihlásenie. Povoľ jej ukladanie údajov a skús to znova.

anotoki.signIn.unavailable.description: The anotoki library's sign-in page: said when the site cannot offer signing in right now (its server did not say where the anotoki accounts are, or they do not know the site). Under it, only the button to try again. No placeholders.
anotoki.signIn.unavailable.en: Signing in is not available right now. Try again in a few minutes.
anotoki.signIn.unavailable.sk: Prihlásenie teraz nie je dostupné. Skús to znova o pár minút.

anotoki.signIn.failed.description: The anotoki library's sign-in page: said when a sign-in came back with any other failure. {code}: the failure's short code ("server_error"), shown as it is, for whoever helps the reader. Placeholders: {code}.

anotoki.signIn.retry.description: The anotoki library's sign-in page: the button under what went wrong that starts the sign-in again. No placeholders.

anotoki.signIn.back.description: The anotoki library's sign-in page: the button under what went wrong that goes back to the page the sign-in started on, without signing in. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.title.description: The anotoki library's feedback form (the form a site's visitors send it a message with): its title, and the name of the dialog a site opens it in. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.lead.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the sentence under its title. No placeholders.
anotoki.feedback.lead.en: Something broken, an idea, a question? Tell us - every message is read.
anotoki.feedback.lead.sk: Niečo nefunguje, máš nápad alebo otázku? Napíš nám - čítame každú správu.

anotoki.feedback.kind.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the question over the kinds of message (something does not work, an idea, something else). No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.kindBug.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the kind of message about something on the site that does not work. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.kindIdea.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the kind of message with an idea for the site. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.kindOther.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the kind of message that is neither (a question, a thank-you). No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.section.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the label of the list of the site's places the message can be about. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.sectionNone.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the first choice of the list of the site's places, for a message about none of them. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.subject.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the label of the message's subject. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.message.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the label of the message itself. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.messageHint.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the hint under the message. No placeholders.
anotoki.feedback.messageHint.en: What happened and what should have happened - or what would be better.
anotoki.feedback.messageHint.sk: Čo sa stalo a čo sa malo stať - alebo čo by bolo lepšie.

anotoki.feedback.email.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the label of the sender's e-mail address, which they may leave empty. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.emailHint.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the hint under the e-mail address. No placeholders.
anotoki.feedback.emailHint.en: Only if you would like an answer. It is used for nothing else.
anotoki.feedback.emailHint.sk: Len ak chceš odpoveď. Na nič iné ju nepoužijeme.

anotoki.feedback.anonymous.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the box a signed-in sender ticks to send the message without their name. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.anonymousHint.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the hint under the box that sends a message without the sender's name. No placeholders.
anotoki.feedback.anonymousHint.en: Neither your account nor your address goes with it.
anotoki.feedback.anonymousHint.sk: Nepôjde s ňou ani tvoj účet, ani tvoja adresa.

anotoki.feedback.send.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the button that sends the message. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.sending.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the button while the message is on its way. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.thanks.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the title said once the message came. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.thanksText.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the sentence under the thanks. No placeholders.
anotoki.feedback.thanksText.en: Your message is on its way to us.
anotoki.feedback.thanksText.sk: Tvoja správa je na ceste k nám.

anotoki.feedback.another.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the button under the thanks that opens an empty form again. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.messageRequired.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: said beside the message when it was sent empty. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.subjectRequired.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: said beside the subject when a message of a kind that needs one was sent without it. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.tooLong.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: said beside a field that is longer than the site takes. {max}: how many characters it takes. Placeholders: {max}.

anotoki.feedback.emailInvalid.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: said beside an e-mail address that is not one. No placeholders.
anotoki.feedback.emailInvalid.en: That does not look like an e-mail address.

anotoki.feedback.tooManyHour.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: said when one sender sent many messages within an hour; the message is not taken. No placeholders.
anotoki.feedback.tooManyHour.en: Thank you - but that is a lot of messages in a short while. Try again in an hour.
anotoki.feedback.tooManyHour.sk: Ďakujeme - no to je veľa správ za krátky čas. Skús to znova o hodinu.

anotoki.feedback.tooManyDay.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: said when one sender, or everybody, sent many messages today; the message is not taken. No placeholders.
anotoki.feedback.tooManyDay.en: Thank you - but there have been a lot of messages today. Try again tomorrow.
anotoki.feedback.tooManyDay.sk: Ďakujeme - no dnes prišlo veľa správ. Skús to znova zajtra.

anotoki.feedback.unavailable.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: said when the site cannot take messages right now (its database waits for an update). No placeholders.
anotoki.feedback.unavailable.en: Messages cannot be sent right now. Try again in a few minutes.
anotoki.feedback.unavailable.sk: Správy teraz nemôžeš poslať. Skús to znova o pár minút.

anotoki.feedback.signInRequired.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: said on a site that takes messages from signed-in people alone, to somebody who is not. No placeholders.
anotoki.feedback.signInRequired.en: Sign in to send a message.

anotoki.feedback.failed.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: said when a message could not be sent for any other reason; what was written stays in the form. No placeholders.
anotoki.feedback.failed.en: The message could not be sent. Try again - what you wrote is still here.
anotoki.feedback.failed.sk: Správu sa nepodarilo poslať. Skús to znova - tvoj text tu stále je.

anotoki.feedback.network.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: said when the site could not be reached at all. No placeholders.
anotoki.feedback.network.en: The site could not be reached. Check the connection, then try again.
anotoki.feedback.network.sk: Stránka nie je dostupná. Skontroluj pripojenie a skús to znova.

anotoki.feedback.honeypot.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the label of a field people never see or reach (robots fill it in, and their messages are dropped) - for a screen reader that finds it anyway. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.clear.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the button at the left of its row of buttons that empties every field. What was typed is kept otherwise - the dialog closed and opened again - until the message is sent or the page is loaded afresh. Short: it stands in one row with Cancel and Send. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.clearName.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: what a screen reader says for the Clear button (anotoki.feedback.clear) - starting with that button's own words, so a person who speaks to the computer names the button by what it shows (WCAG 2.5.3, Label in Name). No placeholders.

anotoki.legalLinks.label.description: The anotoki library's footer links - About, Support and the legal pages (Terms, Privacy, Contact): the name of their group, which a screen reader announces. The links' Slovak addresses nobody - no ty, no Vy - so that it fits every site, the informal ones and the formal survey alike. No placeholders.

anotoki.legalLinks.terms.description: The anotoki library's footer links: the link to the site's terms of use. Short: it stands beside Privacy and Contact. No placeholders.

anotoki.legalLinks.privacy.description: The anotoki library's footer links: the link to the site's privacy policy. Short: it stands beside Terms and Contact. No placeholders.

anotoki.legalLinks.contact.description: The anotoki library's footer links: the link to the site's contact page. Short: it stands beside Terms and Privacy. No placeholders.

anotoki.legalLinks.about.description: The anotoki library's footer links: the link to the About page - the same on every anotoki site: where the name anotoki comes from, who makes the projects, and each project. Short: it stands first, beside Support, Terms, Privacy and Contact. No placeholders.

anotoki.legalLinks.support.description: The anotoki library's footer links: the link to the Support page, where the anotoki projects can be supported on Ko-fi. Short: it stands beside About, Terms, Privacy and Contact. In Slovak a verb ("Podporiť"), never the noun. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.updated.description: The anotoki library's legal pages (Terms, Privacy): the line under the page's heading saying when the page last changed. {date}: the day, written as the page's language writes it ("13 October 2026"). Placeholders: {date}.

anotoki.legal.onThisPage.description: The anotoki library's legal pages (Terms, Privacy): the name of the list of links to the page's own sections, at its top. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.whatFor.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: the label before what a kind of data the site keeps is for. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.howLong.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: the label before how long a kind of data, or a cookie, stays. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.toBeNamed.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: said in brackets after a company the site has not named yet (its hosting company, its mail service), in place of the name. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.copyAddress.description: The anotoki library's legal pages: the button beside the address to write to, which copies it (for somebody whose browser opens no e-mail program). No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.accountPage.description: The anotoki library's legal pages (Privacy, Contact): the link to the anotoki account's page where a person deletes their account. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.accountTitle.description: The anotoki library's legal pages (Terms, Privacy): the heading of the section about the anotoki account - the one account for every anotoki site. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.sectionContact.description: The anotoki library's legal pages (Terms, Privacy): the heading of the last section, how to write about the page. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.otherWays.description: The anotoki library's legal pages (Terms, Privacy): the link to the site's Contact page at the end of the last section. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.fanHoyoverse.description: The anotoki library's legal pages (Terms, Contact), on a site that asks for it (the genshin site, the build analyzer): the fan clause. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.fanHoyoverse.en: This site is a fan-made project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by HoYoverse. Genshin Impact and its names, images and content belong to their respective owners.
anotoki.legal.fanHoyoverse.sk: Táto stránka je fanúšikovský projekt a nie je prepojená so spoločnosťou HoYoverse ani ňou schválená. Genshin Impact a jeho názvy, obrázky a obsah patria ich príslušným vlastníkom.

anotoki.legal.termsTitle.description: The anotoki library's Terms page: its heading, and the tab's title. The legal pages' Slovak addresses nobody - no ty, no Vy - so that it fits every site, the informal ones and the formal survey alike. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.termsLead.description: The anotoki library's Terms page: the sentence under its heading. {site}: the site's name as the site gives it ("anotoki survey"). Placeholders: {site}.
anotoki.legal.termsLead.en: The rules for using {site}, in plain words.

anotoki.legal.termsWhatTitle.description: The anotoki library's Terms page: the heading of the first section, what the site is (the site's own sentence follows it). {site}: the site's name as the site gives it ("anotoki survey"). Placeholders: {site}.

anotoki.legal.termsWhatText.description: The anotoki library's Terms page: the sentence after the site's own words about what it is. {site}: the site's name as the site gives it ("anotoki survey"). {operator}: who runs the site ("Code Hero s.r.o."). Placeholders: {site}, {operator}.
anotoki.legal.termsWhatText.en: {site} is one of the anotoki sites, run by {operator}, and costs nothing to use.
anotoki.legal.termsWhatText.sk: {site} je jednou zo stránok anotoki, prevádzkuje ju {operator} a jej používanie je bezplatné.

anotoki.legal.termsAccountText.description: The anotoki library's Terms page, on every site but the anotoki account's own: what the anotoki account is. {site}: the site's name as the site gives it ("anotoki survey"). Placeholders: {site}.
anotoki.legal.termsAccountText.en: Signing in to {site} uses an anotoki account: one account for every anotoki site, made and kept by the anotoki account's own site.
anotoki.legal.termsAccountText.sk: Na prihlásenie do stránky {site} slúži účet anotoki: jeden účet pre všetky stránky anotoki, ktorý sa zakladá a spravuje na samostatnej stránke účtu anotoki.

anotoki.legal.termsAccountTextIam.description: The anotoki library's Terms page, on the anotoki account's own site (the IAM): what it is. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.termsAccountTextIam.en: This is the anotoki account: one account for every anotoki site.
anotoki.legal.termsAccountTextIam.sk: Toto je účet anotoki: jeden účet pre všetky stránky anotoki.

anotoki.legal.termsAccountCare.description: The anotoki library's Terms page: what a person does to keep their account their own, after what the account is. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.termsAccountCare.en: Keep your password and your authenticator codes to yourself. If you think somebody else has used your account, change your password and write to us.
anotoki.legal.termsAccountCare.sk: Heslo a kódy z overovacej aplikácie treba držať len pre seba. Pri podozrení, že účet použil niekto iný, treba zmeniť heslo a dať nám vedieť.

anotoki.legal.termsAgeTitle.description: The anotoki library's Terms page: the heading of the section about age. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.termsAgeText.description: The anotoki library's Terms page: who may make an account (the owner's decision of 2026-10-13: under 16, with a parent's or guardian's permission). No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.termsAgeText.en: Someone under 16 needs a parent's or guardian's permission to make an anotoki account.
anotoki.legal.termsAgeText.sk: Osoba mladšia ako 16 rokov potrebuje na založenie účtu anotoki súhlas rodiča alebo zákonného zástupcu.

anotoki.legal.termsUseTitle.description: The anotoki library's Terms page: the heading of the section about acceptable use. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.termsUseText.description: The anotoki library's Terms page: what nobody may do with the site, and what may follow. {site}: the site's name as the site gives it ("anotoki survey"). Placeholders: {site}.
anotoki.legal.termsUseText.en: Use {site} lawfully and fairly. Do not try to break into it, overload it or get around its limits; do not use it to harm or harass anyone; and do not send anything unlawful, or anything that is not yours to send. We may block access for anyone who does.
anotoki.legal.termsUseText.sk: Stránku {site} treba používať v súlade so zákonom a slušne. Nie je dovolené pokúšať sa do nej preniknúť, preťažiť ju či obchádzať jej obmedzenia, využívať ju na ubližovanie alebo obťažovanie iných ani posielať čokoľvek nezákonné alebo čokoľvek, na čo odosielateľ nemá právo. Kto tak robí, tomu môžeme zablokovať prístup.

anotoki.legal.termsSendTitle.description: The anotoki library's Terms page: the heading of the section about what people send (feedback, messages). No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.termsSendText.description: The anotoki library's Terms page: what happens with the messages and the feedback people send. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.termsSendText.en: We read every message and every piece of feedback, and may use the ideas in them to improve the anotoki sites, without owing anything for them.
anotoki.legal.termsSendText.sk: Každú správu aj spätnú väzbu čítame a nápady z nich môžeme použiť na zlepšenie stránok anotoki bez nároku na akúkoľvek odmenu.

anotoki.legal.termsAvailabilityTitle.description: The anotoki library's Terms page: the heading of the section about availability and changes. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.termsAvailabilityText.description: The anotoki library's Terms page: a hobby project, and no promise that the site is always there. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.termsAvailabilityText.en: anotoki is a hobby project. A site may change, pause or close, and parts of it may come and go; we cannot promise that it is always available, or that nothing kept on it is ever lost. Keep your own copy of anything that matters to you.
anotoki.legal.termsAvailabilityText.sk: anotoki je hobby projekt. Stránka sa môže meniť, dočasne prestať fungovať alebo skončiť a jej časti môžu pribúdať aj zanikať; nemôžeme sľúbiť, že bude vždy dostupná, ani že sa nič, čo je na nej uložené, nikdy nestratí. Čokoľvek dôležité sa oplatí mať uložené aj inde.

anotoki.legal.termsChangesText.description: The anotoki library's Terms page: that the terms may change, under the availability. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.termsChangesText.en: We may change these terms; the date at the top says when they last changed.
anotoki.legal.termsChangesText.sk: Tieto podmienky môžeme zmeniť; dátum na začiatku stránky uvádza, kedy sa naposledy zmenili.

anotoki.legal.termsWarrantyTitle.description: The anotoki library's Terms page: the heading of the section about warranty and liability. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.termsWarrantyText.description: The anotoki library's Terms page: no warranty, and liability limited as far as Slovak law allows. {site}: the site's name as the site gives it ("anotoki survey"). {operator}: who runs the site ("Code Hero s.r.o."). Placeholders: {site}, {operator}.
anotoki.legal.termsWarrantyText.en: {site} is offered as it is, free of charge and without any warranty. As far as Slovak law allows, {operator} is not liable for loss or damage that comes from using the site or from its not being available. Nothing here limits a liability that the law does not allow to be limited.
anotoki.legal.termsWarrantyText.sk: Stránka {site} sa poskytuje tak, ako je, bezplatne a bez akejkoľvek záruky. V rozsahu, ktorý dovoľuje slovenské právo, {operator} nezodpovedá za stratu ani škodu, ktorá vznikne používaním stránky alebo jej nedostupnosťou. Nič z toho neobmedzuje zodpovednosť, ktorú zákon obmedziť nedovoľuje.

anotoki.legal.termsFanTitle.description: The anotoki library's Terms page, on a site that asks for the fan clause: the heading of its section. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.termsLawTitle.description: The anotoki library's Terms page: the heading of the section about the governing law. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.termsLawText.description: The anotoki library's Terms page: Slovak law, and a consumer's own country's protection. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.termsLawText.en: These terms are governed by the law of the Slovak Republic. A consumer living elsewhere in the European Union keeps the protection the law of their own country gives them.
anotoki.legal.termsLawText.sk: Tieto podmienky sa riadia právom Slovenskej republiky. Spotrebiteľovi s bydliskom v inom štáte Európskej únie zostáva ochrana, ktorú mu poskytuje právo jeho štátu.

anotoki.legal.termsContactText.description: The anotoki library's Terms page: where to write about the terms. {email}: the address to write to (support@anotoki.eu), drawn as a link that opens a new e-mail. Placeholders: {email}.
anotoki.legal.termsContactText.en: Questions about these terms: write to {email}.
anotoki.legal.termsContactText.sk: Otázky k týmto podmienkam možno posielať na {email}.

anotoki.legal.privacyTitle.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: its heading, and the tab's title. The legal pages' Slovak addresses nobody - no ty, no Vy - so that it fits every site, the informal ones and the formal survey alike. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.privacyLead.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: the sentence under its heading. {site}: the site's name as the site gives it ("anotoki survey"). Placeholders: {site}.
anotoki.legal.privacyLead.en: What {site} keeps about you, why, for how long - and what you can do about it.
anotoki.legal.privacyLead.sk: Čo stránka {site} uchováva o ľuďoch, ktorí ju používajú, prečo a ako dlho - a aké práva s tým súvisia.

anotoki.legal.privacyWhoTitle.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: the heading of the section about who runs the site. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.privacyWhoText.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: who runs the site, from where, and that it is the controller in the GDPR's words. {site}: the site's name as the site gives it ("anotoki survey"). {operator}: who runs the site ("Code Hero s.r.o."), a link to its own site. Placeholders: {site}, {operator}.
anotoki.legal.privacyWhoText.en: {site} is run from Slovakia by {operator}, the controller in the words of the GDPR: it decides what the site keeps and why.
anotoki.legal.privacyWhoText.sk: Stránku {site} prevádzkuje zo Slovenska {operator}, prevádzkovateľ v zmysle GDPR: rozhoduje o tom, čo stránka uchováva a prečo.

anotoki.legal.privacyWhoContact.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: where to write about anything on it, in the first section. {email}: the address to write to (support@anotoki.eu), drawn as a link that opens a new e-mail. Placeholders: {email}.
anotoki.legal.privacyWhoContact.en: Write to {email} about anything on this page.
anotoki.legal.privacyWhoContact.sk: S čímkoľvek, čo sa týka tejto stránky, sa možno obrátiť na {email}.

anotoki.legal.privacyKeepsTitle.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: the heading of the section listing what the site keeps. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.privacyKeepsText.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: on which grounds the site keeps what it keeps (the GDPR's Article 6), before the list. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.privacyKeepsText.en: The site keeps only what it needs: to give you what you use it for (Article 6(1)(b) of the GDPR), to keep it safe and working (its legitimate interest, Article 6(1)(f)), and anything else only where it asks for your consent (Article 6(1)(a)), which you can withdraw at any time. Nothing is sold, and nothing is used for advertising.
anotoki.legal.privacyKeepsText.sk: Stránka uchováva len to, čo potrebuje: aby mohla poskytovať to, na čo ju ľudia používajú (článok 6 ods. 1 písm. b) GDPR), aby bola bezpečná a fungovala (oprávnený záujem, článok 6 ods. 1 písm. f) GDPR), a čokoľvek ďalšie len so súhlasom, o ktorý požiada (článok 6 ods. 1 písm. a) GDPR) a ktorý sa dá kedykoľvek odvolať. Nič sa nepredáva a nič sa nepoužíva na reklamu.

anotoki.legal.visitorsName.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page, on a site people can use without an account: the name of what it keeps for them (the site's own words say what and how long). No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.visitorsName.en: Using the site without an account

anotoki.legal.visitorsWhy.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: what the site keeps for people without an account is for, unless the site says it its own way. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.visitorsWhy.en: So that the site can be used without an account.
anotoki.legal.visitorsWhy.sk: Aby sa dala stránka používať aj bez účtu.

anotoki.legal.feedbackName.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page, on a site with the feedback form: the name of what it keeps of the messages. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.feedbackWhat.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: what the feedback form keeps with a message (the anotoki library's form). No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.feedbackWhat.en: What comes with the feedback form: the message, the page it was sent from, the page's language and the browser it was sent with; the sender's account, unless it was sent without a name; and a reply address only if the sender leaves one.
anotoki.legal.feedbackWhat.sk: To, čo príde cez formulár spätnej väzby: správa, stránka, z ktorej bola odoslaná, jazyk stránky a prehliadač, z ktorého bola odoslaná; účet odosielateľa, ak ju neposlal bez mena; a adresa na odpoveď, len ak ju odosielateľ uvedie.

anotoki.legal.feedbackWhy.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: what the feedback is for. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.feedbackWhy.en: To put right what is wrong and make the site better; the site's administrators read it.
anotoki.legal.feedbackWhy.sk: Aby sa dalo opraviť, čo nefunguje, a stránka zlepšiť; čítajú ju správcovia stránky.

anotoki.legal.feedbackKept.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: how long a feedback message stays. {resolvedDays}: the days after it is resolved (365). {spamDays}: the days after it is marked as spam (30). Placeholders: {resolvedDays}, {spamDays}.
anotoki.legal.feedbackKept.en: Until it is dealt with; then {resolvedDays} days after it is resolved, or {spamDays} days after it is marked as spam. When the sender's anotoki account is deleted, the reply address and the browser go from their messages; the words stay.
anotoki.legal.feedbackKept.sk: Kým sa nevybaví; potom {resolvedDays} dní od vyriešenia alebo {spamDays} dní od označenia za spam. Po zmazaní účtu anotoki odosielateľa sa z jeho správ odstráni adresa na odpoveď aj údaj o prehliadači; text správ zostáva.

anotoki.legal.errorLogName.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: the name of the error log. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.errorLogWhat.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: what the error log keeps of a failure (never an IP address: a keyed code of it). No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.errorLogWhat.en: When something fails - on the server or in the page - what failed: the time, the error, the page's address without anything after ? or #, and for someone signed in their account's id. In place of the IP address it keeps a code made from it with a secret key, never the address itself.
anotoki.legal.errorLogWhat.sk: Keď niečo zlyhá - na serveri alebo na stránke v prehliadači - zapíše sa, čo zlyhalo: čas, chyba, adresa stránky bez časti za ? alebo # a pri prihlásenom používateľovi identifikátor jeho účtu. Namiesto IP adresy sa uchováva kód, ktorý z nej vznikne pomocou tajného kľúča, nikdy nie samotná adresa.

anotoki.legal.errorLogWhy.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: what the error log is for. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.errorLogWhy.en: To find and fix what goes wrong.
anotoki.legal.errorLogWhy.sk: Aby sa dali nájsť a opraviť chyby.

anotoki.legal.errorLogKept.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: how long the error log keeps a line. {days}: how many days (30). Placeholders: {days}.

anotoki.legal.auditLogName.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: the name of the audit log. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.auditLogWhat.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: what the audit log keeps, unless the site says it its own way. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.auditLogWhat.en: What the site's administrators do on its admin pages: who changed what, and when.
anotoki.legal.auditLogWhat.sk: Čo robia správcovia stránky na jej administrátorských stránkach: kto čo zmenil a kedy.

anotoki.legal.auditLogWhy.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: what the audit log is for. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.auditLogWhy.en: So that every change can be traced.
anotoki.legal.auditLogWhy.sk: Aby sa dala každá zmena dohľadať.

anotoki.legal.auditLogKept.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: how long the audit log keeps an entry, unless the site says otherwise. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.backupsName.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: the name of the backups. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.backupsWhat.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: what a backup is and when one is made. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.backupsWhat.en: A copy of the site's whole database, made every day, before every update and every restore, and by hand when an administrator asks for one. Each copy holds what the site kept when it was made.
anotoki.legal.backupsWhat.sk: Kópia celej databázy stránky, ktorá vzniká každý deň, pred každou aktualizáciou a obnovením a ručne, keď o ňu požiada správca. Každá kópia obsahuje to, čo stránka uchovávala v čase jej vzniku.

anotoki.legal.backupsWherePlain.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: where the backups are, on a site whose backups are not encrypted. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.backupsWherePlain.en: The copies are kept on the site's server, out of public reach; an administrator may also keep a downloaded copy elsewhere.
anotoki.legal.backupsWherePlain.sk: Kópie sa uchovávajú na serveri stránky, mimo verejného prístupu; správca si môže stiahnutú kópiu uložiť aj inde.

anotoki.legal.backupsWhereEncrypted.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: where the backups are, on a site whose backups are encrypted (the anotoki account's). No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.backupsWhereEncrypted.en: The copies are kept on the site's server, out of public reach, and are encrypted; an administrator may also keep a downloaded copy, encrypted the same way, elsewhere.
anotoki.legal.backupsWhereEncrypted.sk: Kópie sa uchovávajú na serveri stránky, mimo verejného prístupu, a sú šifrované; správca si môže stiahnutú kópiu, rovnako šifrovanú, uložiť aj inde.

anotoki.legal.backupsWhy.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: what the backups are for. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.backupsWhy.en: To bring the site back if something goes badly wrong.
anotoki.legal.backupsWhy.sk: Aby sa dala stránka obnoviť, keby sa niečo vážne pokazilo.

anotoki.legal.backupsKept.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: how long the backups stay - kept by count, not by age. {daily}: how many daily copies are kept (14; a daily copy is made only on a day the site is used). {beforeUpdate}: how many copies made before an update are kept (5). {beforeRestore}: how many made before a restore (5). Placeholders: {daily}, {beforeUpdate}, {beforeRestore}.
anotoki.legal.backupsKept.en: The {daily} newest daily copies (a daily copy is made on a day the site is used); the {beforeUpdate} newest made before an update and the {beforeRestore} newest made before a restore; a copy made by hand until an administrator deletes it. What is deleted on the site stays in the copies made before, until they go.
anotoki.legal.backupsKept.sk: {daily} najnovších denných kópií (denná kópia vzniká v deň, keď sa stránka používa); {beforeUpdate} najnovších kópií pred aktualizáciou a {beforeRestore} najnovších pred obnovením; ručne vytvorená kópia, kým ju správca nezmaže. Čo sa na stránke zmaže, zostáva v skôr vytvorených kópiách, kým nezaniknú.

anotoki.legal.privacyAccountText.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page, on every site but the anotoki account's own: who keeps the account itself (a link to the anotoki account's own privacy policy follows). {site}: the site's name as the site gives it ("anotoki survey"). Placeholders: {site}.
anotoki.legal.privacyAccountText.en: You sign in to {site} with your anotoki account. The account itself - your e-mail address, your password, how you sign in - is kept by the anotoki account's own site, not by {site}: its own privacy policy says what it keeps.
anotoki.legal.privacyAccountText.sk: Na prihlásenie do stránky {site} slúži účet anotoki. Samotný účet - e-mailovú adresu, heslo a spôsob prihlasovania - uchováva samostatná stránka účtu anotoki, nie {site}: čo uchováva, opisujú jej vlastné zásady ochrany osobných údajov.

anotoki.legal.privacyAccountLink.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: the link to the anotoki account's own privacy policy. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.privacyAccountLink.sk: Ochrana osobných údajov v účte anotoki

anotoki.legal.privacyAccountRecord.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page, on every site but the anotoki account's own: what the site keeps of the account, and what happens when the account is deleted. {site}: the site's name as the site gives it ("anotoki survey"). Placeholders: {site}.
anotoki.legal.privacyAccountRecord.en: {site} never sees your password, and it keeps your account's e-mail address only as the reply address of a feedback message you send, if you leave it in the form (on a site that takes feedback). It keeps its own record of you - your account's id, the name the account gives, and what you do here - as listed above. When your anotoki account is deleted, {site} takes your name and any reply address out of what it keeps; what you did here stays, without them.
anotoki.legal.privacyAccountRecord.sk: Stránka {site} heslo nikdy nevidí a e-mailovú adresu účtu si ukladá len ako adresu na odpoveď pri správe so spätnou väzbou, ak sa vo formulári ponechá (na stránkach, ktoré spätnú väzbu prijímajú). Vedie si vlastný záznam - identifikátor účtu, meno, ktoré účet poskytne, a to, čo sa na stránke robí - ako je uvedené vyššie. Po zmazaní účtu anotoki stránka {site} z uchovávaných údajov odstráni meno aj adresu na odpoveď; to, čo sa na nej urobilo, zostane, ale bez nich.

anotoki.legal.privacyAccountTextIam.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page, on the anotoki account's own site (the IAM): what it is, and what each site keeps. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.privacyAccountTextIam.en: This site is the anotoki account itself: one account for every anotoki site. What it keeps is listed above. Each anotoki site you sign in to keeps its own record of you, and its own privacy policy says what; when you delete your account, every site takes your name out of what it keeps.
anotoki.legal.privacyAccountTextIam.sk: Táto stránka je samotný účet anotoki: jeden účet pre všetky stránky anotoki. Čo uchováva, je uvedené vyššie. Každá stránka anotoki, do ktorej sa používateľ prihlási, si vedie vlastný záznam a čo presne, opisujú jej vlastné zásady ochrany osobných údajov; po zmazaní účtu každá stránka odstráni meno z údajov, ktoré uchováva.

anotoki.legal.privacyStorageTitle.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: the heading of the section about cookies and what the site keeps in the browser. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.privacyStorageTitle.en: Cookies and storage in your browser

anotoki.legal.privacyStorageText.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: before the list of the site's cookies and browser storage. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.privacyStorageText.en: The site uses no cookies for advertising or tracking. What it keeps in your browser, it needs in order to work or to remember a choice you made:
anotoki.legal.privacyStorageText.sk: Stránka nepoužíva cookies na reklamu ani na sledovanie. To, čo ukladá v prehliadači, potrebuje na svoje fungovanie alebo na zapamätanie si voľby:

anotoki.legal.storageCookie.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: the kind of a stored item that is a cookie, beside its name. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.storageLocal.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: the kind of a stored item kept in the browser's local storage, beside its name. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.storageSession.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: the kind of a stored item kept in the browser's session storage (gone when the tab closes), beside its name. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.storageHintPurpose.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: what the sign-in hint cookie is (anotoki_signed_in: the anotoki account sets it, every anotoki site reads it; a random value, never who). No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.storageHintPurpose.en: Set by the anotoki account when you sign in, for every anotoki site: it says only that somebody is signed in in this browser - a random value, never who - so that the anotoki sites can sign you in without a click.
anotoki.legal.storageHintPurpose.sk: Nastavuje ho účet anotoki pri prihlásení, pre všetky stránky anotoki: hovorí len to, že v tomto prehliadači je niekto prihlásený - je to náhodná hodnota, nikdy nie údaj o tom, kto - aby stránky anotoki mohli prihlásiť bez kliknutia.

anotoki.legal.storageHintKept.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: how long the sign-in hint cookie stays. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.storageHintKept.en: Until you sign out or close the browser - or, if you asked the anotoki account to keep you signed in, until that sign-in runs out.
anotoki.legal.storageHintKept.sk: Do odhlásenia alebo zatvorenia prehliadača - pri voľbe zostať prihlásený do skončenia tohto prihlásenia.

anotoki.legal.storageSignInPurpose.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: what the site keeps of a person's sign-in in the browser (the tokens the anotoki account gave it, and the sign-in's own notes). No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.storageSignInPurpose.en: Your sign-in to this site - the keys the anotoki account gave it - and small notes the sign-in needs (where it started, and on a site that signs you in without a click, when it last did).
anotoki.legal.storageSignInPurpose.sk: Prihlásenie do tejto stránky - kľúče, ktoré jej vydal účet anotoki - a drobné poznámky, ktoré prihlásenie potrebuje (odkiaľ sa začalo a - na stránke, ktorá prihlasuje bez kliknutia - kedy to naposledy urobila).

anotoki.legal.storageSignInKept.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: how long the sign-in stays in the browser. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.storageSignInKept.en: Until you sign out, or the sign-in ends.

anotoki.legal.storageThemePurpose.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: what the stored theme is. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.storageThemePurpose.en: The look you chose: light or dark.

anotoki.legal.storageLanguagePurpose.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: what the stored language is (with a copy of the site's words in it). No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.storageLanguagePurpose.en: The language you chose, and a copy of the site's words in it, so that the next page opens in it at once.
anotoki.legal.storageLanguagePurpose.sk: Zvolený jazyk a kópia textov stránky v ňom, aby sa ďalšia stránka hneď otvorila v tomto jazyku.

anotoki.legal.storageUntilCleared.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: how long a stored choice (the theme, the language) stays. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.storageUntilCleared.en: Until you choose again, or clear the site's data in your browser.
anotoki.legal.storageUntilCleared.sk: Do ďalšej voľby alebo vymazania údajov stránky v prehliadači.

anotoki.legal.storageVisitorPurpose.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page, on a site people can use without an account: what the visitor's key is. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.storageVisitorPurpose.en: A random key that ties what you do without an account to this browser.
anotoki.legal.storageVisitorPurpose.sk: Náhodný kľúč, ktorý spája to, čo sa robí bez účtu, s týmto prehliadačom.

anotoki.legal.storageVisitorKept.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: how long the visitor's key stays, unless the site says it its own way. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.storageVisitorKept.en: Until you clear the site's data in your browser.
anotoki.legal.storageVisitorKept.sk: Do vymazania údajov stránky v prehliadači.

anotoki.legal.privacyAnalyticsTitle.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: the heading of the section about counting visits (analytics). No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.privacyAnalyticsText.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: how the site counts its visits - the family's own Umami, with no cookie and no personal data. {host}: where the counter runs (umami.anotoki.eu). Placeholders: {host}.
anotoki.legal.privacyAnalyticsText.en: The site counts its visits with Umami, which runs on our own server ({host}). Its script sends the address of the page you open (without anything after ? or #), the page you came from (cut the same way), the page's title, your screen size and your language; the counter works out your browser, system, device type and country from what every browser sends. It sets no cookie, stores nothing in your browser, and keeps no IP address and nothing that names you.
anotoki.legal.privacyAnalyticsText.sk: Stránka počíta návštevy nástrojom Umami, ktorý beží na našom vlastnom serveri ({host}). Jeho skript posiela adresu otvorenej stránky (bez časti za ? alebo #), adresu stránky, z ktorej návšteva prišla (rovnako skrátenú), názov stránky, veľkosť obrazovky a jazyk; prehliadač, systém, typ zariadenia a krajinu počítadlo odvodí z údajov, ktoré posiela každý prehliadač. Nenastavuje žiadne cookie, nič neukladá v prehliadači a neuchováva IP adresu ani nič, čo by niekoho identifikovalo.

anotoki.legal.privacyAnalyticsNone.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page, on a site that counts no visits. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.privacyAnalyticsNone.en: The site counts no visits and uses no analytics.
anotoki.legal.privacyAnalyticsNone.sk: Stránka nepočíta návštevy a nepoužíva žiadnu analytiku.

anotoki.legal.privacyOthersTitle.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: the heading of the section about who else handles data (the hosting company, Cloudflare, Google, the mail service). No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.privacyOthersText.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: before the list of the companies that handle data for the site. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.privacyOthersText.en: When you use the site, a few others handle data too, each only for its own part:
anotoki.legal.privacyOthersText.sk: Pri používaní stránky spracúvajú údaje aj ďalší, každý len v rozsahu svojej úlohy:

anotoki.legal.hostingName.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: the hosting company, in place of its name while the site gives none. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.hostingRole.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: what the hosting company does. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.hostingRole.en: Runs the server the site and its database are on.
anotoki.legal.hostingRole.sk: Prevádzkuje server, na ktorom beží stránka a jej databáza.

anotoki.legal.cloudflareRole.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: what Cloudflare does (the proxy in front of every anotoki site). No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.cloudflareRole.en: Carries every request to the site and back - a proxy in front of it that also protects it from attacks, and may set a cookie of its own to tell people from bots - so it sees your IP address and what your browser asks for. A company based in the USA: data may be handled outside the EU, under the safeguards the GDPR requires.
anotoki.legal.cloudflareRole.sk: Prenáša každú požiadavku na stránku a späť - je to proxy pred stránkou, ktorá ju zároveň chráni pred útokmi a môže nastaviť vlastné cookie na rozlíšenie ľudí od robotov - a preto vidí IP adresu a to, o čo prehliadač žiada. Spoločnosť so sídlom v USA: údaje sa môžu spracúvať aj mimo EÚ, so zárukami, ktoré vyžaduje GDPR.

anotoki.legal.googleRole.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page, on the anotoki account's own site: what Google does when somebody signs in with Google. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.googleRole.en: Only if you choose to sign in with Google: you sign in at Google, which then tells the anotoki account your Google account's id, e-mail address and name. What Google itself keeps, its own privacy policy says. A company based in the USA: data may be handled outside the EU.
anotoki.legal.googleRole.sk: Len pri prihlásení cez Google: prihlásenie prebehne u Googlu, ktorý potom účtu anotoki oznámi identifikátor, e-mailovú adresu a meno účtu Google. Čo uchováva samotný Google, opisujú jeho vlastné zásady ochrany súkromia. Spoločnosť so sídlom v USA: údaje sa môžu spracúvať aj mimo EÚ.

anotoki.legal.mailName.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: the mail service, in place of its name while the site gives none. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.mailRole.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page, on the anotoki account's own site: what the mail service does. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.mailRole.en: Sends the anotoki account's e-mails: address confirmations, password resets, sign-in codes and security notices, and news for those who asked for it.
anotoki.legal.mailRole.sk: Posiela e-maily účtu anotoki: potvrdenia adresy, obnovenie hesla, prihlasovacie kódy, bezpečnostné upozornenia a novinky tým, ktorí o ne požiadali.

anotoki.legal.privacyHowLongTitle.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: the heading of the section that says how long each kind of data stays. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.privacyHowLongText.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: before the list of how long each kind of data stays. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.privacyHowLongText.en: Each part of what the site keeps stays this long:
anotoki.legal.privacyHowLongText.sk: Jednotlivé údaje sa uchovávajú takto dlho:

anotoki.legal.privacyRightsTitle.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: the heading of the section about a person's rights under the GDPR. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.privacyRightsText.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: the rights under the GDPR, and where to ask. {email}: the address to write to (support@anotoki.eu), drawn as a link that opens a new e-mail. Placeholders: {email}.
anotoki.legal.privacyRightsText.en: Under the GDPR you may ask us to show you what we keep about you, to correct it, to delete it, to limit what we do with it, to object to its use where we rely on our legitimate interest, and for a copy of it in a common format to take elsewhere. Write to {email}: we answer within a month, as the GDPR requires.
anotoki.legal.privacyRightsText.sk: Podľa GDPR možno od nás žiadať prístup k uchovávaným údajom, ich opravu, vymazanie a obmedzenie spracúvania, namietať proti spracúvaniu založenému na našom oprávnenom záujme a žiadať kópiu údajov v bežnom formáte na prenos inam. Žiadosti možno posielať na {email}: odpovieme do jedného mesiaca, ako to vyžaduje GDPR.

anotoki.legal.privacyRightsDelete.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: deleting the account on the anotoki account's page (a link to it follows). {days}: the days until the deletion (30). Placeholders: {days}.
anotoki.legal.privacyRightsDelete.en: You can delete your anotoki account yourself on its account page: it closes at once and is deleted {days} days later, and until then you can cancel.
anotoki.legal.privacyRightsDelete.sk: Účet anotoki sa dá zmazať priamo na stránke účtu: hneď sa uzavrie a po {days} dňoch sa zmaže; dovtedy sa dá zmazanie zrušiť.

anotoki.legal.privacyRightsComplaint.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: a complaint to a data protection authority. {authority}: the Slovak authority's name (anotoki.legal.authority), a link to its website. Placeholders: {authority}.
anotoki.legal.privacyRightsComplaint.en: If you think we handle your data wrongly, you can complain to a data protection authority: in Slovakia the {authority}, or the one of the EU country you live in.
anotoki.legal.privacyRightsComplaint.sk: Kto sa domnieva, že s jeho osobnými údajmi zaobchádzame nesprávne, môže sa obrátiť na dozorný orgán: na Slovensku je to {authority}, prípadne dozorný orgán štátu EÚ, v ktorom žije.

anotoki.legal.authority.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: the name of Slovakia's data protection authority, the link to its website (dataprotection.gov.sk) in the sentence about a complaint. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.authority.en: Office for Personal Data Protection of the Slovak Republic (Úrad na ochranu osobných údajov Slovenskej republiky)
anotoki.legal.authority.sk: Úrad na ochranu osobných údajov Slovenskej republiky

anotoki.legal.privacyChangesTitle.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: the heading of the section about changes to the page. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.privacyChangesText.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: how a change to it is shown. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.privacyChangesText.en: When this page changes, the date at the top changes with it.
anotoki.legal.privacyChangesText.sk: Keď sa táto stránka zmení, zmení sa aj dátum na jej začiatku.

anotoki.legal.privacyContactText.description: The anotoki library's Privacy page: where to write about one's data, in the last section. {email}: the address to write to (support@anotoki.eu), drawn as a link that opens a new e-mail. Placeholders: {email}.
anotoki.legal.privacyContactText.en: Questions about your data, or a request: write to {email} - from the address of your anotoki account, or naming it, so that we know whose data it is about.
anotoki.legal.privacyContactText.sk: Otázky k údajom alebo žiadosti možno posielať na {email} - z adresy účtu anotoki alebo s jej uvedením, aby bolo jasné, o čie údaje ide.

anotoki.legal.contactTitle.description: The anotoki library's Contact page: its heading, and the tab's title. The legal pages' Slovak addresses nobody - no ty, no Vy - so that it fits every site, the informal ones and the formal survey alike. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.contactLead.description: The anotoki library's Contact page: the sentence under its heading. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.contactFeedbackTitle.description: The anotoki library's Contact page, on a site with the feedback form: the heading of the section about bugs and ideas. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.contactFeedbackTitle.en: Found a bug or have an idea?

anotoki.legal.contactFeedbackText.description: The anotoki library's Contact page: why to use the feedback form for a bug or an idea. {site}: the site's name as the site gives it ("anotoki survey"). Placeholders: {site}.
anotoki.legal.contactFeedbackText.en: The feedback form is the quickest way: it goes straight to the people who look after {site}.
anotoki.legal.contactFeedbackText.sk: Najrýchlejšie je to cez formulár spätnej väzby: dostane sa priamo k tým, ktorí sa o stránku {site} starajú.

anotoki.legal.contactFeedbackButton.description: The anotoki library's Contact page: the button that opens the feedback form, and the heading of the dialog it opens in. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.contactEmailTitle.description: The anotoki library's Contact page, on a site with the feedback form: the heading of the section about writing an e-mail, after bugs and ideas. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.contactEmailText.description: The anotoki library's Contact page, on a site with the feedback form: what to write about by e-mail. {email}: the address to write to (support@anotoki.eu), drawn as a link that opens a new e-mail. Placeholders: {email}.
anotoki.legal.contactEmailText.en: A privacy question, a copy of your data, anything else: write to {email}.
anotoki.legal.contactEmailText.sk: Otázky o ochrane údajov, žiadosť o kópiu údajov či čokoľvek iné možno poslať na {email}.

anotoki.legal.contactEmailTextAlone.description: The anotoki library's Contact page, on a site without the feedback form: what to write about by e-mail. {email}: the address to write to (support@anotoki.eu), drawn as a link that opens a new e-mail. Placeholders: {email}.
anotoki.legal.contactEmailTextAlone.en: A bug, an idea, a privacy question, a copy of your data, anything at all: write to {email}.
anotoki.legal.contactEmailTextAlone.sk: Chybu, nápad, otázku o ochrane údajov, žiadosť o kópiu údajov či čokoľvek iné možno poslať na {email}.

anotoki.legal.contactEmailAccount.description: The anotoki library's Contact page: to write from the account's address, or name it. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.contactEmailAccount.en: If it is about your account, write from the address your anotoki account uses, or name it in the message.
anotoki.legal.contactEmailAccount.sk: Ak ide o účet, treba písať z adresy, ktorú účet anotoki používa, alebo ju uviesť v správe.

anotoki.legal.contactDeleteTitle.description: The anotoki library's Contact page: the heading of the section about deleting the account. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.contactDeleteText.description: The anotoki library's Contact page: deleting the account oneself, on the anotoki account's page (a link to it follows). {days}: the days until the deletion (30). Placeholders: {days}.
anotoki.legal.contactDeleteText.en: No need to write: you can delete your anotoki account yourself on its account page. It closes at once and is deleted {days} days later; until then you can cancel it there.
anotoki.legal.contactDeleteText.sk: Netreba písať: účet anotoki sa dá zmazať priamo na stránke účtu. Hneď sa uzavrie a po {days} dňoch sa zmaže; dovtedy sa dá zmazanie zrušiť.

anotoki.legal.contactDeleteEverywhere.description: The anotoki library's Contact page, on every site but the anotoki account's own: the account goes for every site, and this one keeps what was done without the name. {site}: the site's name as the site gives it ("anotoki survey"). Placeholders: {site}.
anotoki.legal.contactDeleteEverywhere.en: The account is one for every anotoki site, so it goes for all of them; {site} then keeps what you did here without your name.
anotoki.legal.contactDeleteEverywhere.sk: Účet je spoločný pre všetky stránky anotoki, zmaže sa teda pre všetky; stránka {site} potom ponechá to, čo sa na nej urobilo, bez mena.

anotoki.legal.contactDeleteEverywhereIam.description: The anotoki library's Contact page, on the anotoki account's own site: the account goes for every site, and each keeps what was done there without the name. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.contactDeleteEverywhereIam.en: The account is one for every anotoki site, so it goes for all of them; each site then keeps what you did there without your name.
anotoki.legal.contactDeleteEverywhereIam.sk: Účet je spoločný pre všetky stránky anotoki, zmaže sa teda pre všetky; každá stránka potom ponechá to, čo sa na nej urobilo, bez mena.

anotoki.legal.contactResponseTitle.description: The anotoki library's Contact page: the heading of the section about how soon an answer comes. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.contactResponseText.description: The anotoki library's Contact page: how soon an answer comes - an aim, no promise. No placeholders.
anotoki.legal.contactResponseText.en: We aim to reply within a few days.
anotoki.legal.contactResponseText.sk: Snažíme sa odpovedať do niekoľkých dní.

anotoki.legal.contactAboutTitle.description: The anotoki library's Contact page: the heading of the last section, who runs the site. No placeholders.

anotoki.legal.contactAboutText.description: The anotoki library's Contact page: who runs the site, and from where. {site}: the site's name as the site gives it ("anotoki survey"). {operator}: who runs the site ("Code Hero s.r.o."), a link to its own site. Placeholders: {site}, {operator}.

anotoki.chips.remove.description: The anotoki library's removable chips (the things a person chose or added, each with a small button that takes it away): what a screen reader hears for that button, and its tooltip - the chip's own words in it, so a list of buttons says which. {name}: the chip's words ("Furina", an answer the learner added), as they are shown. Placeholders: {name}.

anotoki.progress.count.description: The anotoki library's progress bar, counting things done: the words beside the bar, and what a screen reader hears for its value - "3 of 10". {value}: how many are done; {max}: how many there are - both numbers written the page's way. Placeholders: {value}, {max}.

anotoki.stepper.stepOf.description: The anotoki library's stepper and progress dots (the steps of a wizard, of a lesson): what a screen reader hears before the current step's name - "Step 2 of 4: Import". Heard, never seen. {current}: the step's number; {total}: how many steps there are. Placeholders: {current}, {total}.

anotoki.stepper.done.description: The anotoki library's stepper and progress dots: what a screen reader hears after the name of a step that is done - "Choose the game, done" (a check mark says it to the eye). Heard, never seen. No placeholders.

anotoki.tabs.scrollBack.description: The anotoki library's tabs and link tabs, where they do not fit their line and scroll sideways: the tooltip of the small arrow at their start that brings the tabs before those in view - seen by a mouse alone, never heard (the keyboard and a screen reader reach every tab itself). No placeholders.

anotoki.tabs.scrollForward.description: The anotoki library's tabs and link tabs, where they do not fit their line and scroll sideways: the tooltip of the small arrow at their end that brings the tabs after those in view - seen by a mouse alone, never heard (the keyboard and a screen reader reach every tab itself). No placeholders.

anotoki.dateField.choose.description: The anotoki library's date field (a date typed, or chosen in a calendar that opens beside it): the name of the small button inside the field that opens the calendar - and its tooltip - and the name of the calendar it opens. {field}: the field's own label ("Birthday", "Opens"), as the page shows it, so that two date fields on a page have two buttons a screen reader tells apart. Placeholders: {field}.

anotoki.dateField.previousMonth.description: The anotoki library's date field: the name and the tooltip of the calendar's button that shows the month before. No placeholders.

anotoki.dateField.nextMonth.description: The anotoki library's date field: the name and the tooltip of the calendar's button that shows the month after. No placeholders.

anotoki.dateField.invalid.description: The anotoki library's date field: said under the field when what was typed is no date it can read ("32.13.", "tomorrow"). {example}: a date written the way the field takes them - 31 December, in the order and with the separators of the reader's date format ("31.12.2026", "12/31/2026"; "31.12." for a day and a month without a year). Placeholders: {example}.

anotoki.dateField.tooEarly.description: The anotoki library's date field: said under the field when the date typed is before the earliest one the field takes. {date}: that earliest date, written the way the field writes dates. Placeholders: {date}.

anotoki.dateField.tooLate.description: The anotoki library's date field: said under the field when the date typed is after the latest one the field takes. {date}: that latest date, written the way the field writes dates. Placeholders: {date}.

anotoki.colorField.picker.description: The anotoki library's colour field (a colour box that opens the device's own colour picker, and a field for the colour's code beside it): what a screen reader hears after the field's label for the colour box - "Text colour, pick from the palette". Heard, never seen. No placeholders.

anotoki.colorField.swatches.description: The anotoki library's colour field: what a screen reader hears after the field's label for the row of suggested colours under it, each a colour with its name - "Text colour, suggested colours". Heard, never seen. No placeholders.

anotoki.colorField.invalid.description: The anotoki library's colour field: said under the field when the colour's code typed is not one it can read. A code is # and six digits 0-9 or letters a-f: keep "#1f5fbf" as it is. No placeholders.
anotoki.colorField.invalid.en: Write the colour as # and six digits or letters a–f, like #1f5fbf.
anotoki.colorField.invalid.sk: Farbu treba zadať ako # a šesť číslic alebo písmen a – f, napríklad #1f5fbf.

anotoki.filePicker.chooseFile.description: The anotoki library's file picker (a button that opens the device's file chooser, and an area a file may be dropped on): the button's words where one file is taken. No placeholders.

anotoki.filePicker.chooseFiles.description: The anotoki library's file picker: the button's words where several files are taken. No placeholders.

anotoki.filePicker.dropFile.description: The anotoki library's file picker: the words in the area a file may be dropped on (with a mouse), beside the button, where one file is taken. Not shown on a touch screen. No placeholders.

anotoki.filePicker.dropFiles.description: The anotoki library's file picker: the words in the area files may be dropped on (with a mouse), beside the button, where several files are taken. Not shown on a touch screen. No placeholders.

anotoki.filePicker.tooLarge.description: The anotoki library's file picker: said when a file chosen or dropped is larger than the site takes, and it was not taken. {name}: the file's name; {size}: its size; {max}: the largest size taken - both written the page's way ("20 MB"). Placeholders: {name}, {size}, {max}.

anotoki.filePicker.wrongType.description: The anotoki library's file picker: said when a file chosen or dropped is not of a kind the site takes, and it was not taken. {name}: the file's name; {types}: the kinds taken, as the site gives them (".json", "image/*"). Placeholders: {name}, {types}.
anotoki.filePicker.wrongType.en: {name} is not a kind of file taken here ({types}).
anotoki.filePicker.wrongType.sk: Súbor {name} nie je z povolených typov ({types}).

anotoki.filePicker.oneOnly.description: The anotoki library's file picker: said when several files are dropped where one alone is taken - none of them was taken. No placeholders.
anotoki.filePicker.oneOnly.en: Only one file can be chosen here.
anotoki.filePicker.oneOnly.sk: Tu sa dá vybrať iba jeden súbor.

anotoki.filePicker.remove.description: The anotoki library's file picker: what a screen reader hears for the small button beside a chosen file that takes it away again, and its tooltip - the file's name in it, so a list of buttons says which. {name}: the file's name. Placeholders: {name}.

anotoki.filePicker.chosen.description: The anotoki library's file picker: what a screen reader is told once files were chosen or dropped (the list under the picker shows them). Heard, never seen. {names}: the names of the files taken, with commas between them. Placeholders: {names}.

anotoki.combobox.noMatches.description: The anotoki library's combobox (a field that lists what matches what is typed, to choose one or several - characters with their portraits): said in the list when nothing matches what was typed, and told to a screen reader. No placeholders.

anotoki.combobox.more.description: The anotoki library's combobox: said under the list when more match than it shows at once, and told to a screen reader. {count}: how many more match, written the page's way. Placeholders: {count}.
anotoki.combobox.more.en: {count} more: keep typing to narrow the list.
anotoki.combobox.more.sk: Ďalších možností: {count} – zoznam zúži ďalšie písanie.

anotoki.combobox.chosen.description: The anotoki library's combobox, where several may be chosen: the name a screen reader hears for the list of the chosen ones over the field (each with a button that takes it away). {field}: the field's own label, as the page shows it. Heard, never seen. Placeholders: {field}.

anotoki.richText.toolbar.description: The anotoki library's rich-text toolbar (the row of buttons over a text editor that make words bold, a list, a link): its name, where the site gives none. No placeholders.

anotoki.richText.bold.description: The anotoki library's rich-text toolbar: the name and the tooltip of the button that makes the words bold. No placeholders.

anotoki.richText.italic.description: The anotoki library's rich-text toolbar: the name and the tooltip of the button that makes the words italic. No placeholders.

anotoki.richText.underline.description: The anotoki library's rich-text toolbar: the name and the tooltip of the button that underlines the words. No placeholders.

anotoki.richText.strike.description: The anotoki library's rich-text toolbar: the name and the tooltip of the button that strikes the words through. No placeholders.

anotoki.richText.bulletList.description: The anotoki library's rich-text toolbar: the name and the tooltip of the button that makes the lines a bulleted list. No placeholders.

anotoki.richText.orderedList.description: The anotoki library's rich-text toolbar: the name and the tooltip of the button that makes the lines a numbered list. No placeholders.

anotoki.richText.indent.description: The anotoki library's rich-text toolbar: the name and the tooltip of the button that indents the lines more. No placeholders.

anotoki.richText.outdent.description: The anotoki library's rich-text toolbar: the name and the tooltip of the button that indents the lines less. No placeholders.

anotoki.richText.link.description: The anotoki library's rich-text toolbar: the name and the tooltip of the button that makes the words a link (the site asks for its address). No placeholders.
